detector.name: Gcp VertexAI detector
detector.programText:
from signalfx.detectors.population_comparison import population
A = data('publisher/online_serving/model_invocation_latencies').publish(label='A')
population.detector(population_stream=A, group_by_property=None, fire_num_dev=3.5, fire_lasting=lasting('15m', 1), clear_num_dev=3, clear_lasting=lasting('15m', 1), strategy='median_MAD', orientation='above', auto_resolve_after='15d').publish('Gcp VertexAI Model Invocation Latency Outliner Detector')

rules.description: The value of publisher/online_serving/model_invocation_latencies is more than 3.5 median absolute deviation(s)  above the  median of similar signals for 100% of 15m.
